name: Boutwell Steel Company
old_description: At Boutwell Steel, we supply pipe, steel, and metal materials for ranches, contractors, fabricators, and property owners throughout Dripping Springs and the surrounding Hill Country. Alongside steel sales, we build custom steel driveway gates and offer in-house welding and custom fabrication tailored to each project. From raw materials to finished pieces, everything is built with a focus on durability, function, and craftsmanship.
about:
Boutwell Steel Company operates from Dripping Springs, Texas, serving the surrounding Hill Country region. The company supplies pipe, steel, and metal materials while also building custom steel driveway gates and providing in-house welding and fabrication services. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed in public materials.

The business runs a full-service welding and fabrication facility that handles projects ranging from heavy equipment repair to structural steel work. Its sales center stocks structural pipe in sizes such as 2-3/8, 2-7/8, and 4-1/2 inches, along with bollards, base plates, square and rectangular tubing, flat bar, angle iron, round bar, C-channel, landscape steel, Corten steel, expanded metal, and steel plate in thicknesses from 14 gauge to one inch. Additional inventory includes hinges, post caps, edging, and stainless steel. The company also offers delivery, cutting, and fabrication on purchased materials.

Customers include ranches, contractors, fabricators, and property owners throughout the Hill Country. Concrete examples of work include custom driveway gates marketed as Texas Edition Gates, heavy equipment welding, and structural steel fabrication for local projects.

The company emphasizes durability, function, and craftsmanship in its finished pieces, positioning its gates and fabricated items as Texas-made products. A full-service facility allows it to move from raw material to completed project under one roof.
